passages.text: Later, the prophets Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them.
passages.sermon:
Haggai was a prophet.
Zechariah was also a prophet.
Zechariah was the son of Iddo.
Haggai and Zechariah spoke to the Jews.
These Jews lived in Judah and Jerusalem.
Haggai and Zechariah spoke as prophets.
They spoke in the name of the God of Israel.
The God of Israel had authority over the Jews.
passages.original: וְהִתְנַבִּ֞י חַגַּ֣י נְבִיאָה וּזְכַרְיָ֤ה בַר־ עִדּוֹא֙ נְבִיאַיָּא עַל־ יְה֣וּדָיֵ֔א דִּ֥י בִיה֖וּד וּבִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם בְּשֻׁ֛ם אֱלָ֥הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֲלֵיהֽוֹן׃ס

passages.text: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak rose up and began to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. And the prophets of God were with them, helping them.
passages.sermon:
Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel.
Jeshua was the son of Jozadak.
Both men were leaders of the Jews in Jerusalem.
They rose up.
They began to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem.
The prophets of God were with them.
The prophets helped them.
passages.original: בֵּאדַ֡יִן קָ֠מוּ זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בַּר־ שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ וְיֵשׁ֣וּעַ בַּר־ יֽוֹצָדָ֔ק וְשָׁרִ֣יו לְמִבְנֵ֔א בֵּ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירֽוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְעִמְּה֛וֹן נְבִיאַיָּא דִֽי־ אֱלָהָ֖א מְסָעֲדִ֥ין לְהֽוֹן׃פ

passages.text: At that time Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates went to the Jews and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?”
passages.sermon:
Tattenai was the governor of the region west of the Euphrates.
Shethar-bozenai was with him.
Their associates were also with them.
They went to the Jews in Jerusalem.
They spoke to the Jews.
They asked a question.
They said, “Who gave you permission to rebuild this temple?”
They also said, “Who allowed you to restore this structure?”
passages.original: בֵּהּ־ זִמְנָא֩ אֲתָ֨א עֲלֵיה֜וֹן תַּ֠תְּנַי פַּחַ֧ת עֲבַֽר־ נַהֲרָ֛ה וּשְׁתַ֥ר בּוֹזְנַ֖י וּכְנָוָתְה֑וֹן וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לְהֹ֔ם מַן־ שָׂ֨ם לְכֹ֜ם טְעֵ֗ם בַּיְתָ֤א דְנָה֙ לִבְּנֵ֔א וְאֻשַּׁרְנָ֥א דְנָ֖ה לְשַׁכְלָלָֽה׃ס

passages.text: They also asked, “What are the names of the men who are constructing this building?”
passages.sermon:
Tattenai was the governor of the region west of the Euphrates.
Shethar-bozenai was with him.
Their associates were also present.
They spoke to the Jews who were rebuilding the temple in Jerusalem.
They asked a question.
They said, “What are the names of the men who are building this structure?”
passages.original: אֱדַ֥יִן כְּנֵ֖מָא אֲמַ֣רְנָא לְּהֹ֑ם מַן־ אִנּוּן֙ שְׁמָהָ֣ת גֻּבְרַיָּ֔א דִּֽי־ דְנָ֥ה בִנְיָנָ֖א בָּנַֽיִן׃

passages.text: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, so that they were not stopped until a report was sent to Darius and written instructions about this matter were returned.
passages.sermon:
God watched over the elders of the Jews.
God protected them.
No one stopped the elders from building.
They continued their work.
This lasted until officials sent a report to King Darius.
They waited for written instructions about the matter.
passages.original: וְעֵ֣ין אֱלָהֲהֹ֗ם הֲוָת֙ עַל־ שָׂבֵ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֔א וְלָא־ בַטִּ֣לוּ הִמּ֔וֹ עַד־ טַעְמָ֖א לְדָרְיָ֣וֶשׁ יְהָ֑ךְ וֶאֱדַ֛יִן יְתִיב֥וּן נִשְׁתְּוָנָ֖א עַל־ דְּנָֽה׃פ

passages.text: This is the text of the letter that Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates, the officials in the region, sent to King Darius.
passages.sermon:
Tattenai was the governor of the region west of the Euphrates River.
Shethar-bozenai worked with Tattenai.
Other officials in the region also worked with them.
These men sent a letter to King Darius.
This is the text of their letter.
passages.original: פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן אִ֠גַּרְתָּא דִּֽי־ שְׁלַ֞ח תַּתְּנַ֣י׀ פַּחַ֣ת עֲבַֽר־ נַהֲרָ֗ה וּשְׁתַ֤ר בּוֹזְנַי֙ וּכְנָ֣וָתֵ֔הּ אֲפַ֨רְסְכָיֵ֔א דִּ֖י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה עַל־ דָּרְיָ֖וֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽא׃

passages.text: The report they sent him read as follows: To King Darius: All peace.
passages.sermon:
Tattenai was the governor of the region west of the Euphrates.
Shethar-bozenai and their associates were officials in that region.
They sent a letter to King Darius.
They sent a report to him.
The report began with a greeting.
The report said, “To King Darius: All peace.”
passages.original: פִּתְגָמָ֖א שְׁלַ֣חוּ עֲל֑וֹהִי וְכִדְנָה֙ כְּתִ֣יב בְּגַוֵּ֔הּ לְדָרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א שְׁלָמָ֥א כֹֽלָּא׃ס

passages.text: Let it be known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God. The people are rebuilding it with large stones, and placing timbers in the walls. This work is being carried out diligently and is prospering in their hands.
passages.sermon:
Tattenai is the governor of the region west of the Euphrates.
Shethar-bozenai and their associates are officials in that region.
They sent a letter to King Darius.
They wrote to inform the king about events in Judah.
We went into the province of Judah.
We went to the house of the great God.
The people are rebuilding the house.
They are using large stones.
They are placing timbers in the walls.
The people are working diligently.
The work is prospering in their hands.
passages.original: יְדִ֣יעַ׀ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְמַלְכָּ֗א דִּֽי־ אֲזַ֜לְנָא לִיה֤וּד מְדִֽינְתָּא֙ לְבֵית֙ אֱלָהָ֣א רַבָּ֔א וְה֤וּא מִתְבְּנֵא֙ אֶ֣בֶן גְּלָ֔ל וְאָ֖ע מִתְּשָׂ֣ם בְּכֻתְלַיָּ֑א וַעֲבִ֥ידְתָּא דָ֛ךְ אָסְפַּ֥רְנָא מִתְעַבְדָ֖א וּמַצְלַ֥ח בְּיֶדְהֹֽם׃ס

passages.text: So we questioned the elders and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?”
passages.sermon:
We spoke to the elders in Judah.
We asked them a question.
We said, "Who gave you permission to rebuild this temple?"
We also asked, "Who allowed you to restore this building?"
passages.original: אֱדַ֗יִן שְׁאֵ֙לְנָא֙ לְשָׂבַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֔ךְ כְּנֵ֖מָא אֲמַ֣רְנָא לְּהֹ֑ם מַן־ שָׂ֨ם לְכֹ֜ם טְעֵ֗ם בַּיְתָ֤א דְנָה֙ לְמִבְנְיָ֔ה וְאֻשַּׁרְנָ֥א דְנָ֖ה לְשַׁכְלָלָֽה׃

passages.text: We also asked for their names, so that we could write down the names of their leaders for your information.
passages.sermon:
We asked the elders for their names.
We wanted to know who they were.
We planned to write down the names of their leaders.
We wanted to give you this information.
passages.original: וְאַ֧ף שְׁמָהָתְהֹ֛ם שְׁאֵ֥לְנָא לְּהֹ֖ם לְהוֹדָעוּתָ֑ךְ דִּ֛י נִכְתֻּ֥ב שֻׁם־ גֻּבְרַיָּ֖א דִּ֥י בְרָאשֵׁיהֹֽם׃ס

passages.text: And this is the answer they returned: “We are servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and completed.
passages.sermon:
The elders gave this answer.
They said, “We are servants of the God of heaven and earth.
We are rebuilding the temple.
This temple was built many years ago.
A great king of Israel built this temple.
He also completed it.”
passages.original: וּכְנֵ֥מָא פִתְגָמָ֖א הֲתִיב֣וּנָא לְמֵמַ֑ר אֲנַ֣חְנָא הִמּ֡וֹ עַבְדוֹהִי֩ דִֽי־ אֱלָ֨הּ שְׁמַיָּ֜א וְאַרְעָ֗א וּבָנַ֤יִן בַּיְתָא֙ דִּֽי־ הֲוָ֨א בְנֵ֜ה מִקַּדְמַ֤ת דְּנָה֙ שְׁנִ֣ין שַׂגִּיאָ֔ן וּמֶ֤לֶךְ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רַ֔ב בְּנָ֖הִי וְשַׁכְלְלֵֽהּ׃

passages.text: But since our fathers angered the God of heaven, He delivered them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean who destroyed this temple and carried away the people to Babylon.
passages.sermon:
Our fathers angered the God of heaven.
God rules over all heaven.
God rules over all earth.
God became angry with our fathers.
God gave our fathers into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar was a Chaldean.
Nebuchadnezzar destroyed this temple.
Nebuchadnezzar carried the people away to Babylon.
passages.original: לָהֵ֗ן מִן־ דִּ֨י הַרְגִּ֤זוּ אֲבָהֳתַ֙נָא֙ לֶאֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א יְהַ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ בְּיַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל כַּסְדָּיָא וּבַיְתָ֤ה דְנָה֙ סַתְרֵ֔הּ וְעַמָּ֖ה הַגְלִ֥י לְבָבֶֽל׃ס

passages.text: In his first year, however, Cyrus king of Babylon issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.
passages.sermon: Cyrus was the king of Babylon.\r\nIn his first year as king, Cyrus made a decree.\r\nHe commanded that this house of God should be rebuilt.
passages.original: בְּרַם֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֔ה לְכ֥וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א דִּ֣י בָבֶ֑ל כּ֤וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא֙ שָׂ֣ם טְעֵ֔ם בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֥א דְנָ֖ה לִבְּנֵֽא׃

passages.text: He also removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles belonging to the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken and carried there from the temple in Jerusalem. King Cyrus gave these articles to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he appointed governor and instructed, ‘Take these articles, put them in the temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its original site.’
passages.sermon:
Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylon.
He took gold and silver articles from the temple in Jerusalem.
He carried these articles to the temple in Babylon.
These articles belonged to the house of God.
King Cyrus became king after Nebuchadnezzar.
King Cyrus removed these gold and silver articles from the temple in Babylon.
King Cyrus gave these articles to a man named Sheshbazzar.
King Cyrus appointed Sheshbazzar as governor.
King Cyrus told Sheshbazzar, “Take these articles.”
King Cyrus said, “Go and put them in the temple in Jerusalem.”
King Cyrus said, “Let the house of God be rebuilt on its original site.”
passages.original: וְ֠אַף מָאנַיָּ֣א דִֽי־ בֵית־ אֱלָהָא֮ דִּ֣י דַהֲבָ֣ה וְכַסְפָּא֒ דִּ֣י נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר הַנְפֵּק֙ מִן־ הֵֽיכְלָא֙ דִּ֣י בִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֔ם וְהֵיבֵ֣ל הִמּ֔וֹ לְהֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י בָבֶ֑ל הַנְפֵּ֨ק הִמּ֜וֹ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗א מִן־ הֵֽיכְלָא֙ דִּ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וִיהִ֙יבוּ֙ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֣ר שְׁמֵ֔הּ דִּ֥י פֶחָ֖ה שָׂמֵֽהּ׃ וַאֲמַר־ לֵ֓הּ׀ אֵלֶּה מָֽאנַיָּ֔א שֵׂ֚א אֵֽזֶל־ אֲחֵ֣ת הִמּ֔וֹ בְּהֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּבֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א יִתְבְּנֵ֥א עַל־ אַתְרֵֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem, and from that time until now it has been under construction, but it has not yet been completed.”
passages.sermon:
Sheshbazzar was the governor appointed by King Cyrus.
Sheshbazzar came to Jerusalem.
He laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem.
From that time, the house of God has been under construction.
The house of God has not yet been completed.
passages.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֣ר דֵּ֔ךְ אֲתָ֗א יְהַ֧ב אֻשַּׁיָּ֛א דִּי־ בֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּמִן־ אֱדַ֧יִן וְעַד־ כְּעַ֛ן מִתְבְּנֵ֖א וְלָ֥א שְׁלִֽם׃

passages.text: Now, therefore, if it pleases the king, let a search be made of the royal archives in Babylon to see if King Cyrus did indeed issue a decree to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. Then let the king send us his decision in this matter.
passages.sermon:
The people spoke to the king.
They asked the king to do something.
They wanted the king to search the royal archives in Babylon.
They wanted to know if King Cyrus had made a decree.
They wanted to know if King Cyrus had ordered the house of God in Jerusalem to be rebuilt.
They asked the king to send them his decision about this matter.
passages.original: וּכְעַ֞ן הֵ֧ן עַל־ מַלְכָּ֣א טָ֗ב יִ֠תְבַּקַּר בְּבֵ֨ית גִּנְזַיָּ֜א דִּי־ מַלְכָּ֣א תַמָּה֮ דִּ֣י בְּבָבֶל֒ הֵ֣ן אִיתַ֗י דִּֽי־ מִן־ כּ֤וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְמִבְנֵ֛א בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֥א דֵ֖ךְ בִּירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּרְע֥וּת מַלְכָּ֛א עַל־ דְּנָ֖ה יִשְׁלַ֥ח עֲלֶֽינָא׃ס
